runner: Existing OptimizerWindow backpropagates numerator/accumulation_steps; optimizer-window normalization divides once by globally summed denominator.

nla.note: Per-sample normalization stays differentiable in numerator; no extra weighted-token reduction.

dpace.numerator: sum over N,A,B of native masked detached_credit * unsmoothed_CE
dpace.note: Do not divide numerator by N before returning RatioTerms; all chunks of one input batch contribute N exactly once.

bv.numerator: sum of original per-complete-block training scalars/gradient surrogates
bv.note: Retain original profile/schedule/numerics. Separate logged mathematical objective and gradient-surrogate scalar.

mixed_objective_gate: Implemented exact native independent normalizations: precompute optimizer-window layouts and global denominators; encode common reference denominator and reuse OptimizerWindow. Native denominators remain FP32/FP64, not BF16.
loss_field: TrainingOutput.loss is for compatible logging/local view; runner backpropagates loss_terms.numerator. Do not assume loss.backward() matches the actual runner.
